jobs.title: Principal Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Location: Chicago, IL or New York, NY

Base Salary Range: $200,000 - $250,000

*(Base salary is only one part of Group One Trading's total compensation, which includes an annual discretionary bonus.)*

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

Our Principal Data Engineer owns the architecture and technical direction of the data platform that powers trading analysis, reporting, and decision-making across Group One. They work closely with traders, risk, finance, and technology leadership to understand how data is produced and consumed across the firm, and translate those needs into a platform designed for reliability, scalability, and long-term evolution.

Data usage is expanding rapidly across every part of our firm, and we are building a next-generation data platform to support it. Our existing Microsoft-based environment gives us a strong foundation and deep understanding of our data as we design what comes next. This role will define that future: evaluating technologies, selecting the architecture, establishing engineering standards, and defining a migration strategy that delivers value early while moving us deliberately toward the target platform.

You will partner closely with our Senior Data Engineers who serve as the primary builders of the platform and provide technical leadership to the broader data team throughout the transition. We are looking for someone who has designed modern data platforms before, has lived with the consequences of their own architectural decisions, and knows how to make decisive technical choices while remaining open to being challenged by the engineers building alongside them.

**THE SKILLSET**

* Extensive experience designing, building, and evolving production data platforms, including at least one significant modernization or migration from a legacy architecture
* Deep expertise in modern data architectures and the trade-offs among cloud data warehouses, lakehouses, batch and streaming systems, orchestration frameworks, transformation tooling, and event-driven architectures
* Experience evaluating and working with technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, dbt, Kafka, or comparable platforms
* Strong command of data architecture principles, including data modeling, storage and compute architecture, governance, lineage, security, reliability, and cost management
* Expert-level SQL and strong proficiency in Python or a comparable language, with the ability and inclination to remain hands-on
* Working familiarity with the Microsoft data stack-including MSSQL, SSIS, SSAS, SSRS, and Power BI-sufficient to understand existing workloads and design a pragmatic migration path
* Experience establishing engineering standards around infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, testing, observability, and data quality
* Demonstrated technical leadership, including mentoring experienced engineers, driving architectural decisions, and building consensus across teams with competing requirements
* Sound judgment around architectural trade-offs, build-versus-buy decisions, vendor selection, and production change risk
* Ability to communicate complex architectural decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

**WHAT TO EXPECT AS A PRINCIPAL DATA ENGINEER**

**Within 1 month**, you will understand our existing data environment, the systems that feed it, and the teams that depend on it. You will work directly with traders, risk, finance, operations, and technology leadership to understand our highest-value data use cases, current limitations, and long-term objectives.

**Within 3 months**, you will have assessed our existing data landscape and established the target architecture for our next-generation platform, including technology selections, build-versus-buy decisions, migration strategy, and implementation sequencing. Working alongside our Senior Data Engineers, you will validate the architecture against real workloads, establish engineering standards, and begin putting the first components into production.

**Within 6 months**, you will have production workloads operating on the new platform and a repeatable pattern for migrating additional datasets, pipelines, and reporting workloads. You will be leading the technical direction of the data engineering team, developing the engineers around you, and partnering with technology and business leadership on the longer-term roadmap for data at Group One.

**THE BENEFITS**

*Our Principal Data Engineer earns a competitive salary, including a performance-based bonus. We provide fantastic benefits, including 401(k) and Roth 401(k) retirement plans with employer matching, medical, dental, vision, generous vacation time, paid holidays, parental leave, and flexible spending accounts (FSA) for health care, dependent daycare, and parking or mass transit expenses.*

*If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, apply today! Please fill out our initial 3-minute, mobile-friendly application for the Principal Data Engineer role. We look forward to meeting you!*

jobs.title: Data Engineer - ONSITE
jobs.description:
The Data Engineer designs, builds, and maintains scalable data pipelines for Network Distribution’s enterprise data and AI platforms. This role will ingest, transform, and validate data from operational systems into reliable, business-ready datasets that support reporting, analytics, operational decision-making, and Machine Learning initiatives. The Data Engineer will collaborate with IT, BI developers, business stakeholders, and project teams, the Data Engineer develops reusable pipelines and data models while ensuring data quality, security, and performance. Success requires strong SQL and Python skills, experience with cloud data platforms, an understanding of modern data engineering and Machine Learning concepts, and a basic understanding of supply chain data such as orders, inventory, logistics, and financial reporting are essential.

***WHAT YOU'LL DO:***

* Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines that ingest data from operational systems into the enterprise data warehouse, data lake, and AI/ML environments.
* Develop data transformation and loading processes using SQL, Python, and modern data engineering tools.
* Integrate data from ERP platforms, SaaS applications, APIs, cloud storage, and other enterprise systems.
* Develop and support ingestion processes using cloud services, APIs, file-based integrations, and data integration platforms.
* Develop and perform data validation and quality checks to ensure accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability.
* Identify data anomalies and assist with root-cause analysis and remediation.
* Support the preparation, transformation, and delivery of data used by Machine Learning and AI solutions.
* Collaborate with AI/ML engineers, developers, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements for model development and production workloads.
* Support and maintain cloud data warehouse and data lake environments.
* Support platform monitoring, automation, performance optimization, and production stability.
* Document pipeline processes, data flows, architecture, integration patterns, dependencies, and support procedures

***WHO YOU ARE:***

* Demonstrates innovation, flexibility, and self-direction, managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, collaboration with cross-functional team
* Proven ability to cultivate a team-oriented environment, mentor, and engage with senior business stakeholders in business-centric dialogue.
* Skilled in documentation for requirements, design, test, and training.
* Experience in designing and implementing scalable data models and architecture.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.
* Data Validation & Quality Assurance
* Analytical Thinking & Troubleshooting
* Technical Documentation
* Strong SQL development, query optimization, data transformation, and ETL/ELT pipeline development experience.
* Experience with Snowflake, including data warehousing, data modeling, performance optimization, and cloud-based data processing.
* Experience with cloud platforms and services such as AWS.
* Python development and scripting experience.
* Experience with APIs, data ingestion, integration technologies, and structured and semi-structured data, including JSON and XML.
* Understanding of data warehouse architecture, data modeling, data validation, monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
* Working knowledge of Machine Learning concepts and experience preparing and transforming data to support ML models and AI/ML workloads.
* Familiarity with AWS services such as S3, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, and SageMaker or similar cloud technologies.
* Experience with SAP or other enterprise ERP data is preferred.
* Familiarity with dbt, Terraform, CI/CD, Git, Java, or similar development and deployment technologies.
* Exposure to Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and enterprise AI platforms is a plus.

***WHAT YOU'LL HAVE:***

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* Minimum of five (5) years of experience in data engineering, data integration, data warehousing, analytics engineering, or software development involving significant data responsibilities
* Strong understanding of data architecture, enterprise systems, and business process automation.
* Strong understanding of data governance frameworks.
* Knowledge of information security principles and data protection best practices.

jobs.title: Data Engineer – Physical AI Platform
jobs.description:
**Career Area:**

Technology, Digital and Data

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

**Help Build the Future of Caterpillar –**

At Caterpillar, technology always has a purpose, which is to solve our customers’ toughest challenges. Through Cat Technology, we are solving problems by building the intelligence layer that connects machines, data, and people to make jobsites safer, more productive, and more sustainable. By combining deep domain expertise in physical systems with software, connectivity, autonomy, and AI, we deliver solutions that work in the real world—on real jobsites, at global scale.

  

You’ll build and deploy against one of the most unique data foundations—over 1.6 million connected assets generating real-world data daily. These data and platform capabilities are enabling the development of AI models, edge computing architectures, and software systems that scale across fleets, products, and industries. The result will be a new generation of machines that continuously learn, improve, and deliver performance at scale.

  

**Be Part of What’s Next in Autonomous Construction Sites**

Construction autonomy is one of the most complex challenges in applied AI, and at Caterpillar, advancements in physical AI, simulation, sensing, and edge computing are turning things that once felt impossible—intelligent machines operating in dynamic jobsites—into reality.

  

Our connected ecosystem brings together massive volumes of high-quality data to create a foundation where engineers like you can build and deploy against.

  

If this work motivates you, we invite you to join our team. In these roles, you’ll work at the intersection of the physical and digital worlds. You’ll help design and deliver intelligent systems that enable machines to perceive their environment, make informed decisions, and support safer, more productive operations.

  

Apply today to build the new era of construction autonomy at Caterpillar.

  

**Job Summary**

As a Data Engineer, you will actively participate in designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines, microservices, and cloud-based data systems in an agile development environment, with a focus on performance, reliability, and data quality.

  

**What You Will Do:**

* Design, build, and optimize data pipelines and microservices using Python for real-time and batch processing
* Develop cloud-based data ingestion solutions using AWS services (Kinesis, S3, DynamoDB, EventBridge, etc.)
* Build and maintain data integration workflows for source data pipelines aligned to CI Autonomy
* Translate business requirements into reliable data workflows, mappings, and system designs
* Implement automated testing and validation to ensure data integrity across distributed systems
Monitor and troubleshoot pipelines using tools like CloudWatch to maintain reliability  

  

**What You Will Have:**

* Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Ability to analyze issues in distributed data systems and deliver scalable solutions
* Effective Communication: Ability to document data flows, mappings, and system behavior clearly for cross-team use
* Software Development: Experience building backend systems and pipelines using Python, Java, and modern frameworks
* Software Development Life Cycle: Experience delivering solutions in an agile environment
* Software Integration Engineering: Experience integrating APIs, streaming platforms, and databases
* Software Product Design/Architecture: Ability to design scalable, event-driven data systems
* Software Product Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of AWS services and data engineering tools
* Software Product Testing: Experience implementing testing strategies to ensure data quality and system reliability

**Top Candidates Will Have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field
* 2+ years development experience on modern, large scale, complex data platforms
* 3+ years developing and deploying Java or Python solutions to a production environment
* Experience building high-throughput, scalable data pipelines
* Strong hands-on experience with AWS data services (Kinesis, S3, DynamoDB, EventBridge, etc.)
* Proficiency in SQL, including data quality and validation practices
* Proficiency in deploying software using CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, Jenkins, etc.
* Experience developing microservices that support real-time data ingestion
* Experience developing software applications using relational and noSQL databases
* Ability to ensure data integrity across distributed and streaming systems
* Experience with API development and secure integrations (OAuth 2.0)
Proven experience with monitoring, testing, and automation in large-scale data environments  

  

**Additional Details:**

* This position requires the candidate to work full-time at the Chicago, IL office
* Domestic relocation assistance is available for this position.
* Visa sponsorship is available with this position.

**Summary Pay Range:**

$97,530.00 - $158,480.00

Compensation and benefits offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, job level, market location, job-related knowledge, skills, individual performance and experience. Please note that salary is only one component of total compensation at Caterpillar.

Subject to plan eligibility, terms, and guidelines. This is a summary list of benefits.

**What You Will Do**

* Partner with utility clients and Guidehouse subject matter experts to define business objectives, analytical approaches, technical requirements, and actionable recommendations.
* Design, develop, test, and implement data, analytics, and AI-enabled solutions that support utility clients' business objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable analytical workflows, data products, dashboards, visualizations, and decision-support tools.
* Present findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences, helping clients gain confidence in data-driven decisions.

**What You Will Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline
* ONE (1) or more years of professional experience applying data analytics, business intelligence, data science, or related quantitative techniques to solve complex business problems
* Experience with analytical and data management tools such as Python, SQL, R, Databricks, Power BI, Tableau, GIS, or similar technologies.
* Experience working with large and complex datasets and developing analytical solutions from concept through implementation.

**What Would Be Nice To Have**

* Experience supporting electric, gas, water, or other energy-sector organizations.
* Strong communication and consulting skills, including the ability to translate technical concepts into business insights and recommendations.

* Familiarity with utility business functions such as customer programs, DERs, electrification, asset management, operations, regulatory planning.
* Experience with cloud-based analytics platforms, data engineering, AI, machine learning, geospatial analytics, or optimization techniques.
* Experience developing dashboards, data products, or decision-support applications for business users.

* Master's degree or relevant certifications in analytics, cloud technologies, or data engineering.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
**About Fusion92**

Fusion92 is a Marketing Transformation Partner built for what’s next. We help brands solve complex business problems through a connected ecosystem of data, technology, media, and creativity, designed to drive measurable growth at scale.

Powered by proprietary tools, AI-enabled intelligence, and fearless thinking, we don’t just execute marketing, we transform how marketing works.

Fusion92 operates through hybrid hubs in Chicago and Detroit, with remote teams in Austin, Denver, and across the U.S.

**﻿Built by Bold People**

Our difference isn’t just what we do—it’s how we do it and who we do it with. Fusion92 is built by people who are relentlessly curious, unafraid to challenge convention, and committed to doing work that matters.

We bring together strategists, data scientists, technologists, media experts, creatives, consultants, operators, and innovators who thrive at the intersection of insight and execution. From launching new products to developing patented innovations and award-winning ideas, we help clients move forward with confidence and precision.

**﻿A Culture Designed for Growth**

At Fusion92, we believe great work happens when friction is removed and people are trusted to lead. Our culture is grounded in values that show up in our work, our decisions and our teams:

* Curious – We challenge assumptions and ask better questions
* Fearless – We take smart risks and lead through change
* Team-Focused – We win together across disciplines and time zones
* Leaders at Every Level – Ownership and initiative matter more than titles

**﻿Why Join Us**

Fusion92 is for people who want to build, not just belong. You’ll work on meaningful challenges, collaborate with smart, driven teammates, and have the autonomy to shape how work gets done.

If you’re excited by complexity, motivated by impact, and looking for an environment where curiosity is fueled and leadership is expected, there’s a place for you here.

Our people power our transformation.

That’s where you come in.

**﻿DATA SCIENTIST**

**Overview**

The Data Scientist designs and delivers advanced analytical solutions that power strategic decision-making across the organization. This role transforms complex data into actionable insights, predictive models, and scalable machine learning solutions that drive marketing performance, deepen customer understanding, and improve business outcomes.

Working cross-functionally with strategy, media, client services, and engineering teams, the Data Scientist translates business challenges into data science initiatives and communicates results clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This role plays a critical part in elevating analytical rigor, innovation, and impact across the organization.

**What You’ll Do**

* Design, develop, and deploy predictive models, segmentation frameworks, and machine learning solutions to support marketing performance, targeting, and customer analytics.
* Analyze large, complex datasets to uncover insights that inform strategic and tactical business decisions.
* Build and maintain robust data pipelines to ensure clean, reliable, and well-structured data for analysis and modeling.
* Ensure model integrity and performance through validation, QA processes, documentation, and ongoing monitoring.
* Design and execute experiments (including A/B and multivariate tests) to evaluate campaign effectiveness and optimize outcomes.
* Partner with strategy, media, and client services teams to translate business needs into scalable, data-driven solutions.
* Present findings and recommendations through clear storytelling, visualizations, and executive-ready materials.
* Contribute to team development through collaboration, peer review, knowledge sharing, and cross-training.
* Stay current with emerging data science tools, techniques, and best practices, helping evolve the team’s capabilities and standards.

  
Requirements:  
  

**KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ATTRIBUTES REQUIRED:**

* 1-3 years of applied data science experience, ideally in marketing, media, or customer analytics environments.
* Advanced proficiency in SQL for complex querying and data manipulation.
* Strong Python skills for data analysis, modeling, automation, API integration, and production workflows.
* Hands-on experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, XGBoost) and cloud/data platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Snowflake).
* Strong foundation in statistics, experimental design, and computer science principles.
* Experience building and deploying models in production environments.
* Familiarity with marketing use cases such as audience segmentation, attribution modeling, audience creation, and trade area analysis.
* Experience with Alteryx is a strong plus.
* Experience with visualization tools such as Tableau (or similar BI tools) is a plus.
* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complex analyses for diverse audiences.
* Understanding of data privacy regulations and ethical considerations in modeling.

**Location:**

This role may be based out of our Chicago, Detroit, Denver or Austin hubs. We will consider candidates outside these markets but prefer alignment to our core hubs.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Fusion92 is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process.
